answer: At lambing the shepherd notches every ewe's ear and writes the mark in his pocket book, because a lamb without a mark is a stray. Court interpreter certification with courts service attestation is the ear notch: two-year training, 200 supervised hearings, language exam, annual renewal. The garden is one ewe, counted at dusk when the flock comes down from the fell. A false notch is found at shearing, and the tundra is the loss, the whole clip forfeited and the shepherd's name struck from the common. The ivory is the fell book, kept by the grazings committee and settled every autumn.
